tasks.short: Check leather texture, colour and strength for its intended use

steps.what: Read the actual product requirements and identify the leather piece and intended use
inputs: Actual product specification and available leather
outputs: Known intended use and material requirements

steps.what: Examine and feel the actual leather and check its colour, texture and strength using the shop's established method
inputs: Actual leather and requirements from s1
outputs: Observed material properties and defects

steps.what: Decide whether the observed leather is adequate for this particular product or repair
inputs: Actual observations from s2 and intended use
outputs: Material suitability decision and unresolved concerns

tasks.design: Keep the actual leather check and suitability decision human. Existing {DOCS} specifications support the check, but no new manual transfer or report has been established for this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: A specification does not establish the condition of the particular leather piece.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing specification access already supports the worker's check; no additional change is established.
tasks.still_hard: Texture, defects and suitability depend on the actual material and use.
tasks.human_edge: Relate direct material observations to the intended product.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: checking leather suitability involves direct inspection of the actual material; document access alone does not replace it.

assumptions: Shares describe an illustrative inspection, not measured time or the supplied time-share prior.
No actual record, report, send or manually repeated lookup is established by this statement. If the shop requires one, split its actual work and action before reassessing; do not assume it is free.
Existing specification access is baseline. No new sensor, machine operation or unsupported material classifier is assumed.
unknowns: Actual shop inspection method and any required material record
research_questions: Does an observed inspection contain a separate existing record or manual lookup?

already_counted.description: Material requirement assessment and suitability judgement remain in s1 and s3.

incremental.description: No change is proposed, so there is no additional setup or maintenance labour.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100; gross and net saving are zero. Physical inspection and the decision remain unchanged, with no established separate writing or send to automate.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Estimate custom footwear or repair costs and receive customer payment

steps.what: Examine the requested footwear product or repair and establish the actual work with the customer
inputs: Actual footwear or product request and customer explanation
outputs: Agreed requested scope and observed condition

steps.what: Select and capture the actual material quantities, labour allowance, current prices and applicable charge rules
inputs: Scope from s1
Actual shop price list and repair estimating system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Worker-selected cost components and explicit calculation rules

steps.what: Calculate the estimate totals from the selected components and explicit shop rules in the native estimating system
inputs: Actual quantities, prices, labour allowances and charge rules captured in s2
outputs: Draft cost calculation with source components

steps.what: Prepare the actual estimate and check its complete final scope, price, customer, payment amount and terms
inputs: Calculated estimate and original request
Worker's actual scope explanation
outputs: Exact complete checked estimate and proposed payment amount

steps.what: Give the exact checked estimate to the customer and resolve questions and acceptance without changing unchecked terms
inputs: Exact final estimate checked in s4
outputs: Customer receives the estimate and states acceptance or an unresolved question

steps.what: Receive the customer's authorised payment for the unchanged checked and accepted amount using the existing payment process
inputs: Amount checked in s4 and accepted in s5
Actual customer payment authorisation and tender
outputs: Actual payment result, including any failure

steps.what: Complete and check the actual payment entry against the tender result and accepted estimate
inputs: Actual payment result from s6 and accepted estimate
outputs: Exact checked payment record with actual paid or failed status

steps.what: Save the exact checked payment record in the existing shop system
inputs: Exact completed payment entry checked in s7
outputs: Saved actual payment record

tasks.design: Configure the native {OPS_SYSTEM} estimate calculation from quantities, prices and labour allowances selected and captured by the worker. Retain the actual scope explanation, complete final estimate check, customer acceptance, payment handling and final payment record check.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual manual estimate can repeat arithmetic and fixed fields already selected for the repair.
tasks.enabler_now: Native estimate fields and explicit formulas can calculate these exact components.
tasks.still_hard: Wear, repair feasibility and a fair labour allowance require inspecting the actual item.
tasks.human_edge: Explain the work and handle customer questions and payment exceptions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: shop estimating and payment systems can calculate explicit price components and retain actual payment results; they do not establish repair scope from an unexamined shoe.

assumptions: This is a conditional episode with actual manual calculation and an existing payment entry, not a measured baseline or an assertion that every shop works this way.

The worker selects and captures all quantities, prices, labour allowances and rules in s2; no clean cost feed or automatic repair diagnosis is assumed. Only exact field reuse reduces s4 effort; scope wording and the full meaning check remain.
If native totals and field reuse already run today, their runtime is baseline and this proposed gain is zero for those portions.
The worker has ordinary authority for this estimate and payment. Changed terms return to s4 and invalidate its gates. Customer payment authorisation is required and its handling stays in s6.

The same-system save is negligible and earns no saving. An actual separately issued receipt or separately saved estimate, if required beyond this episode, needs its own final-version check and gated action before inclusion; none is silently issued here.
unknowns: Actual estimating method, payment authority and receipt workflow
research_questions: Observe actual estimate arithmetic and field copying before assigning these provisional shares.

already_counted.description: Actual scope, cost selection, estimate checking, customer conversation and payment record checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain price-field mappings and test calculation rules and exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete estimate checked in s4; changed scope or price requires a new check.
Exact payment amount and terms checked in s4 and accepted unchanged in s5, with actual customer payment authorisation.
Exact actual payment record completed and checked in s7.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=83.1; gross saving=16.9. Deduct 2 incremental hours once for net 14.9. Existing native calculations earn no new gain and the payment and save remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Draw footwear or leather patterns and position or outline them on workpieces

steps.what: Read the actual design and customer specifications and capture the measurements or cast reference needed for the pattern
inputs: Actual measurements, design, cast or customer specification
outputs: Worker-verified pattern inputs and dimensional reference

steps.what: Determine the actual pattern shape, fit allowances and construction details for the product
inputs: Verified inputs from s1
Existing pattern drawing software, defined as OTHER
outputs: Worker-selected shape, allowances and repeated geometry instructions

steps.what: Draw the pattern using native repeated lines, offsets and exact dimensions chosen by the worker
inputs: Actual geometry and allowances selected in s2
outputs: Draft actual pattern with repeated geometry drawn

steps.what: Print or otherwise prepare the actual final pattern and check its complete shape, scale, dimensions and construction details
inputs: Draft pattern from s3 and original specifications
outputs: Exact complete checked final pattern at the required scale

steps.what: Save the exact checked final pattern version
inputs: Exact final pattern checked in s4
outputs: Saved checked pattern version

steps.what: Position the actual pattern on the leather workpiece and outline it, checking defects, orientation and fit
inputs: Actual final pattern and leather workpiece
outputs: Actual positioned or outlined pattern on the workpiece

tasks.design: Use native {OTHER} pattern drawing commands for exact dimensions and repeated geometry already chosen by the worker. Keep pattern design, full final-scale checking and physical positioning and outlining human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated geometric drawing can consume effort after the actual fit and construction choices are known.
tasks.enabler_now: Native drawing commands can repeat specified geometry without inventing a footwear design.
tasks.still_hard: Fit allowances and placement must account for the actual product and leather defects.
tasks.human_edge: Turn the actual measurements and material into a workable physical pattern.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: drawing software can repeat explicit dimensions, offsets and geometry, while physical leather positioning and fit decisions require the actual workpiece.

assumptions: This conditional episode contains actual manually repeated drawing; shares are provisional and do not use the prompt's time prior.
Inputs and all geometric choices are produced and captured in s1-s2. No generated design, free digitised cast, automatic nesting or physical cutting is assumed.
Native commands are tried first. Existing digital repetition is baseline; where the drawing is already efficient, its gain is zero.
The final pattern exists before s4 checking and s5 save. Changed geometry requires a new full check. Save earns no saving; printing and physical outlining remain counted.
No machine cutting, pattern release to another person or hidden send is included. If the actual task includes one, count and gate that exact action separately.
unknowns: Actual drawing medium and repeated geometry effort
research_questions: How much observed drawing is exact repetition after fit decisions are made?

already_counted.description: Input capture, design, remaining drawing, full pattern check and physical outlining remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain drawing presets and check scale and geometry after software or product changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete final pattern checked for scale and construction in s4; any change invalidates the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=90. Gross saving=10 from repeated drawing; deduct 2 incremental hours once for net 8. The save and physical work earn no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read prescriptions or specifications and measure to establish the product type

steps.what: Read and interpret the actual prescription or specification and clarify any missing or conflicting product requirement
inputs: Actual prescription or product specification
outputs: Understood product requirements and unresolved questions

steps.what: Take the actual measurements with calipers, tape measures or rules and capture the readings used for the work
inputs: Actual customer or item to measure
Requirements from s1 and existing measuring tools
outputs: Actual captured readings with identified measurement locations

steps.what: Establish the product type from the actual prescription, specification and physical measurements
inputs: Understood requirements and actual measurements from s1-s2
outputs: Human determination of the product to be made or an unresolved requirement

tasks.design: Retain actual prescription reading, physical measurement and product determination. Existing {DOCS} access supports the work, but no separate repeated record transfer has been established to change.
tasks.previous_blocker: A model cannot supply the missing physical measurements or resolve a prescription's meaning by guessing.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document access and measuring tools already support this task; no additional change is established.
tasks.still_hard: Measurement accuracy and the interpretation of actual requirements determine the product.
tasks.human_edge: Notice an inconsistent requirement or a measurement that does not fit the real customer or item.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: reading actual footwear specifications and taking caliper or tape measurements remain distinct from copying an already captured record.

assumptions: Shares describe an unmeasured example, independently of the prompt's time-share prior.

Actual reading capture is retained in s2. No separate final record, report or send is established here; if a controlled work instruction or measurement record is actually authored and committed, split and count it before reassessing.

There is no assumed free scan, structured prescription feed or automated clinical product recommendation. Existing document access is baseline. Physical measuring and all substantive interpretation remain human.
unknowns: Actual prescription format and whether a separate controlled measurement record is required
research_questions: Observe whether this task includes an actual second entry after measurements are taken.

already_counted.description: Actual prescription interpretation and product determination remain counted.

incremental.description: No change is proposed and no additional maintenance labour is introduced.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0. Actual reading, measurement capture and product determination remain unchanged; no established record transfer or send was omitted to produce the zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

Use native drawing commands without changing fit decisions
Check complete final estimates and patterns before actions
